text:
Hannah K: Heads-up — QuantumCore sent final logo pack and draft joint announcement copy. We need a quick asset review: marketplace tile, hero banner, logo lockup rules, quote attribution, and alt text. Target publish next Thursday.
Omar (design): Downloaded the ZIP. Two immediate issues: the white reversed mark has a hairline anti-aliasing artifact at 1x PNGs; compact mark scales fine. For the hero, the horizontal lockup looks fine at 1200px but clips at 480px. Suggest increasing left clearspace by 6px.
Rita S: Draft announcement copy looks good but we need byline approve for the quote. QuantumCore draft uses "Head of HW Partnerships" which is informal. Tom, any legal concerns?
Tom B (Legal): We need formal title or explicit permission to use informal title. Also request partner sign-off on the quote and asset use. Send back the consent template and ask them to initial section 2.
QuantumCore Ops: Confirmed: official title is "Leila Park, VP Strategic Partnerships". We attach signed asset consent (doc QC-2026-AG). Also uploaded a clean SVG and PNGs to shared drive: https://files.redwood.com/quantumcore/assets_v1.zip
Omar (design): Perfect. Will re-export 1x PNGs with flattened edges to remove anti-aliasing halo. For marketplace micro-tile (140x140) use compact mark centered with 8px clearspace, provide SVG + PNG 140x140 + 280x280. For hero banner use horizontal lockup with added clearspace; CTA color tweak needed — current #0072ff fails AA on dark hero image. Recommend #0051b2.
MarketplaceOps: Reminder: microtile metadata limits: title <=60 chars, short desc <=140 chars, alt text <=125 chars. Also we run automated contrast check on CTA during staging. Please paste final strings here for validation.
Hannah K: Proposed strings:
- title: QuantumCore + Redwood Inference: On-prem inferencing for AI (56 chars)
- short_desc: Joint solution enabling low-latency, on-prem LLM inference with optimized batching and quantization (114 chars)
- alt_text: QuantumCore logo  on-prem inference hardware partner for Redwood Inference (95 chars)
Omar (design): Small nit: remove control chars from alt_text; recommend: "QuantumCore compact mark 0 on-prem inference hardware for Redwood Inference". But better: "QuantumCore compact mark  on-prem inference hardware partner for Redwood Inference" — will tidy.
Tom B (Legal): Quote consent attached and title confirmed. No legal blockers. Please ensure the partner's full company name used per their brand guide: "QuantumCore Systems, Inc." in the announcement headline.
QuantumCore Ops: Confirmed — you can use "QuantumCore Systems, Inc." in the headline and the byline "Leila Park, VP Strategic Partnerships". Also we approve the short_desc and alt_text once you remove any invisible/control chars.
Hannah K: Great. Omar, can you upload revised exports to the same folder and confirm CTA color to #0051b2? Rita, please update announcement copy to use full legal name in headline and Leila's formal title in byline. MarketplaceOps, ping here when you validate strings and AA. We'll aim to schedule publish Thursday AM.
Omar (design): Will upload updated assets (SVG + PNGs @1x/2x) and hero preview to https://files.redwood.com/quantumcore/exports_v2 by EOD. CTA set to #0051b2.
Rita S: Editing copy now — swapping headline to include "QuantumCore Systems, Inc." and quoting Leila Park's approved line: "Partnering with Redwood let us halve latency on critical inference workloads." Will paste final copy once done.
MarketplaceOps: I'll run contrast and metadata checks after assets are uploaded. If all clear, we'll slot the publish for Thursday 09:00 PT. Ping me when uploads complete.
Hannah K: Checklist: 1) Omar exports and fixes PNG halos; 2) Rita updates announcement copy with full partner name and formal title; 3) Tom confirms consent (done); 4) MarketplaceOps validates CTA/alt text and schedules publish. Thanks team! :sparkles:
